title: Hall anomaly in mixed state of superconductors and vortex dynamics
abstract: The present author has long argued, with concrete predictions, that both longitudinal and transverse (Hall) resistivities in the mixed state of superconductors are dominated by vortex many-body effect. Hence there is no need to introduce various ad hoc vortex dynamics theories. It is interesting to note this point of view is now slowly creeping into the work of his most fierce opponents.
